name: go-tools-boundary-aware-graph-analysis
instr:
go-tools cannot currently represent ordered entry and exit boundaries shared by graph transformations, analyses, IR consumers, and DOT output. Add this capability for a selected region containing exactly the nodes reachable from an entry that can reach an exit. Keep boundary-unaware behavior and serialization unchanged.

Expose `Boundaries`, `BoundaryGraph`, `BoundaryError`, `BoundaryRole`, `BoundaryEntry`, `BoundaryExit`, and `ValidateBoundaries`. Validation must report the missing node and role before observable analysis work begins. `CompactBoundaries` must preserve boundary order and membership through its returned index. `TransposeBoundaries` must swap the ordered roles and be behaviorally involutive.

`BoundaryPostorder`, `BoundaryReversePostorder`, `BoundaryReachable`, `BoundaryAllPaths`, and `BoundarySCCs` must visit declared entries in order and deterministically cover the entire selected region, including cyclic and rootless selected components. `BoundaryShortestPath` must reject endpoints outside the region with `BoundaryError` and retain outgoing-edge tie-breaking.

A `Function` must expose stable block-index boundaries including every terminal block, and `NewBoundaryFunction` must support multiple entries. `BoundaryForward` must seed every declared entry without invoking transfer or exposing facts outside the region. `BoundaryDominators` must return a `DominatorForest` rooted for all entries without fabricated blocks, while preserving established single-entry dom
